scope: Explored same-session spatial cropping and separate full/crop support counterfactual. Not independent acceptance. Spatial crop rejected for new errors; conservative supplement is not promoted.

rule.scope: Exploratory label-blind spatial gap rule, frozen before development replay. Parameters examined on 27 training-source images only. Not a production feature.
rule.fallback: keep original preprocessed full ROI when no unique eligible gap

spatialTrial.scope: 170 same-session development XYZ,141 absent,8 unknown;27 training-source fit diagnostics separately. Frozen rule-v1, unchanged weights/parser. Not independent acceptance.

postHocSupportTrial.scope: Separate post-hoc counterfactual after observing v1 crop failures. Development already explored, not independent validation. No parser or spatial rule modified.

supportProbe.policy: preserve full returns; support cropped XYZ in both geometry views; no label-based choice
